Hi! I'm Andree, a health data scientist from Peru working in epidemiology, serology, and outbreak research. I bridge epidemiology and data science to make outbreak analytics more accessible through teaching and open science.

I've trained epidemiologists across four continents: Peru, Colombia, Chile, the UK, Uganda, and The Gambia. I developed and organised the short course on outbreak analytics and applied modelling in R at the **London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM)**, and wrote tutorials and how-to guides for **Epiverse-TRACE**.

I also develop [R packages](resources.qmd), such as {serosurvey}, {covid19viz}, and {epitidy}, to close the gap between methods and field practice. If you work on infectious disease response or epidemic modelling, I'd love to [connect](https://www.linkedin.com/in/avallecam/).
